condition: Lazy pl.concat(how="horizontal") keeps at least one column from every input, even inputs none of whose columns are selected later, so unused branches still get computed (a performance limitation, not a wrong result).
workaround: Set POLARS_PROJECTION_PUSHDOWN_PRUNE_STRICT_HCONCAT_INPUTS=1 for the whole process to let the optimizer drop unused inputs. This also skips their height check.
